Paragraph: "While those best monkeys hopped everywhere they have frightened deer, wildcats and tigers on that great mountain..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Spread of alarm to other creatures in the ecosystem due to group flight.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: The monkeys' erratic movements terrify local wildlife, including apex predators.
Outcome/Resolution: Panic ripples outward, disrupting the peace of the mountain.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Ripple Effect of Fear, Systemic Distress

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bhaya-Trasa (Transmitting terror to surrounding living beings)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Fear creates a cascade effect, disturbing the natural peace of all beings in its vicinity.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Systemic anxiety: fear behaviors in one subgroup triggering stress responses across neighboring populations.
